# TrueMemory

> Universal memory infrastructure for AI and software.

TrueMemory is the memory layer for agents, applications, models, sessions, and Spaces. TrueMemory Assistant is a first-party client built on the platform.

## Current interfaces

- REST API: `/v1/memories`, `/v1/memories/search`, `/v1/memories/retrieve`, `/v1/memories/update`, `/v1/memories/forget`
- MCP: `POST /mcp`
- API & SDK guide: `/api-sdk`
- Human and agent documentation: `/docs`

## Authentication

Use an authenticated API token with the `memory` scope. Tokens can be bound to a Space (`workspace_id`) and agent (`agent_id`). Bindings are enforced by the API boundary.

## Memory model

Memory supports scoped keys and content, source/provenance, confidence, temporal validity, search, retrieval, revision, forgetting, and history-aware access where available.
